1f75de8f6fb857036c3811ce45a5c85af4b5c1d2.sourceText: “位姿图”可理解为：记录各帧扫描时车辆的位置、朝向，以及帧与帧之间的相对关系。求解器在有这些约束且触发优化时，调整二维x、y、yaw，使约束更一致。它不优化Point-LIO的三维IMU状态，也不替代small_gicp的PCD定位。
1f75de8f6fb857036c3811ce45a5c85af4b5c1d2.translatedText: A "pose graph" can be understood as: recording the vehicle's position and orientation during each frame scan, as well as the relative relationships between frames\. When these constraints are present and optimization is triggered, the solver adjusts the 2D x, y, and yaw to make the constraints more consistent\. It does not optimize the 3D IMU state of Point-LIO, nor does it replace the PCD localization of small_gicp\.
